You have been told that the offers were made by participants in earlier laboratory experiments. For each proposal, choose accept or reject. Acceptance implements the stated allocation; rejection gives both players zero for that proposal. You receive 5 yuan for participating. At the end, the computer randomly selects one of the trials in which you accepted an offer, and your additional payment is based on that trial. There are 20 main trials in a random order, with no time limit. F means accept and J means reject. After each response, a one-second feedback screen marks your own response. Use the current proposal and your completed-trial history. Reply only accept or reject.
